captured_state.isolation_strategy: Zitadel management API uses REST gateway paths under /management/v1/ (org-scoped). Do NOT use gRPC Connect paths. For IdP setup: create_provider creates the IdP, enable_auth_method adds it to the logi
captured_state.jwt_idp_flow_doc: To test JWT IdP validation: 1) mint_custom_jwt → captures minted_token. 2) start_idp_intent with idp_id={{jwt_idp_id}} → captures auth_url, plus auto-parsed auth_url_authRequestID and auth_url_userAge

finding.sequence_description: Config change + re-auth: disable external IdPs in login policy, then attempt JWT IdP login again. If still accepted, broker policy is not enforced (authorization binding to broker policy).
finding.description: [LLM-Judge] External IdP login was still accepted (HTTP 200) after external IdPs were disabled in the application's login policy, indicating policy enforcement bypass.

evidence.llm_judge_description: External IdP login was still accepted (HTTP 200) after external IdPs were disabled in the application's login policy, indicating policy enforcement bypass.

sequence.description: Config change + re-auth: disable external IdPs in login policy, then attempt JWT IdP login again. If still accepted, broker policy is not enforced (authorization binding to broker policy).
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Broker policy (login policy allow_external_idp) must constrain effective authentication/authorization; disabling external IdPs must prevent JWT IdP-based login from succeeding.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control: when external IdPs are allowed, JWT IdP login should succeed.
JWT IdP login succeeded even though broker policy disabled external IdPs, violating authorization binding to BrokerPolicy.
